# Architecture: General

VEPA4 is a browser simulation with a main-thread orchestrator, optional physics worker, flat particle memory, stateless lawgroup primitives, a spatial-neighbor path, and a programmatic UI. The source is modular JavaScript ESM and Vite packages the browser entrypoint.

## Responsibilities

| Boundary | Responsibility | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Main thread | Bootstrap, UI, rendering, worker bridge and world orchestration | [src/main.js](../../../src/main.js) |
| Worker | Initialize/configure buffers and execute serialized physics ticks | [src/worker/physics.worker.js](../../../src/worker/physics.worker.js) |
| Solver | Build neighbors, gate laws, integrate bounded motion and run lifecycle | [src/physics/solver.js](../../../src/physics/solver.js) |
| State | Own buffers, masks, runtime parameters, persistence and subsystem state | [src/state](../../../src/state) |
| UI | Create controls against DOM, EventBus and runtime contracts | [src/ui](../../../src/ui) |
| Renderer | Project live particle state into canvas/Pixi output | [src/render](../../../src/render) |

## Current contract

- Particle stride: `100` floats.
- Species DNA count: `64`.
- Declared law count: `136`.
- Source records scanned: `601`.

The generated module inventory is the detailed API index. This document describes ownership and execution boundaries rather than reproducing every function.
